recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-12653 unless a future work-group decision revisits the DocumentReference.date name, cardinality, or datatype.
issue_request: FHIR-12653 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification DSTU2 change request for DocumentReference.indexed. The accepted resolution was to make .indexed 0..1 and rename it to "date"; comments clarified that the element records when the DocumentReference, not the underlying document, was created.
initial_application: Git commit 94e532a611046fcdc40df2d7d28457eeb7dad3a6 appears to be the original application. Its San Diego WGM block-vote message lists GF#12653, and the relevant DocumentReference spreadsheet/example changes moved DocumentReference.indexed 1..1 to DocumentReference.date 0..1, kept indexed as an alias, and updated example element tags.
additional_context: DocumentReference is active in source/fhir.ini. The current XML source defines DocumentReference.date as 0..1 with alias indexed, and the date search parameter uses DocumentReference.date. FHIR-13281 is the same indexed-cardinality family and is already represented on the combined branch. Later applied FHIR-43625 intentionally changed DocumentReference.date from instant to dateTime and added precision guidance, explaining the current datatype without conflicting with FHIR-12653.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because no current source edit is needed. Current source has no active DocumentReference.indexed element path, active DocumentReference examples use date, and the later dateTime datatype is covered by FHIR-43625.
